source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify key areas of non-compliance.
3. Take high-resolution photographs.
4. Record the date, time, and weather conditions.
5. Document specific observable fire hazards.
6. Note any evidence of previous fire incidents.
7. List fire safety equipment deficiencies.
8. Detail any structural weaknesses or harm.
9. Include statements from the inspector or witnesses.
10. Explain the immediate actions recommended.
11. Outline the potential risks and consequences.
12. Secure permission to carry out subsequent checks.
13. Log any attempts to contact building occupants or owners.
14. Confirm the presence of emergency exits and their condition.
15. Relay any conversations with personnel or occupants.
16. Review compliance history to identify patterns.
17. Attach any correspondence from regulatory authorities.
18. Ensure all documentation is timestamped and signed.
19. Compile a formal report detailing all findings.
20. Provide a list of recommended corrective measures.
21. Ensure confidentiality and data protection standards are maintained
